post_content:
It's been exactly a year, I have started implementing hashtag#deepwork in my
life. The results, definitely are astounding. Next few days, I will share my
experiences over here. Stay tuned The first step I did was to quit social
media - I was never on twitter, Instagram etc. I used only LinkedIn, Facebook
and Whats app. After I read hashtag#deepwork by Cal Newport, I uninstalled
whats app and deactivated Facebook. Being an entrepreneur with a people facing
role , this was the toughest. I know how many people cursed me when I made
them text on SMS. The results are worth !!

I always feel learning about your favorite topic in your mother tongue helps
to connect with it better. Nothing brings more joy than seeing a book on
Machine Learning written in Tamil. Nithya has done a good job of writing this
book with clear examples. https://lnkd.in/gEBZgQc Selvakumar Murugan please
